backend/main.mo: Motoko backend handling user profiles, admin allowlist, role assignment, signup flows including admin-password validation, and full system reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature-to-file mapping describing implemented features, related source files, components, and test IDs with confidence metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files detailing their purpose, behavior, and interactions with backend features.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide describing normal upgrades, fresh publishes, reset procedures, verification steps, and troubleshooting.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based style definitions using OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes and shared UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entrypoint that loads the React application via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app router managing authentication, profile setup, error states, protected admin routes, and overall layout rendering.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Component displaying an admin‑restricted access warning with a button returning users to the home page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header component showing logo, navigation links, admin options, and logout controls based on authentication state.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Login screen handling Internet Identity login, signup, stale sessions, and account switching.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: User signup form collecting profile details, validating input, and submitting engineer or admin account creation.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Screen shown when a session is invalid, prompting user to log out and sign in again.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Provides full logout flow clearing identity, storage, React Query cache, and reloading the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, signup, and other backend interactions with logging and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using an industrial color palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and mounts it to the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin interface for listing, deleting, purging, and resetting users and system data, with access control and dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays detailed information for a single service report with loading, error handling, and a styled layout.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new service report, including validation, submission, and success handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Lists all service reports with search and date filters, providing navigation and error/loading states.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Provides helpers to detect missing-profile vs real authentication errors by matching message patterns.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears auth‑related localStorage and sessionStorage keys to ensure a clean logout state.
Extracts and sanitizes backend signup errors and maps them to friendly user‑facing messages.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes sensitive data and logs signup flow events without exposing secrets or PII.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validates signup fields like required text, email format, and mobile number structure.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with extended color tokens, animations, and plugin setup.
project_state.json: Tracks project configuration, existing features, admin signup requirements, and architectural notes.
